s1.syndrome_frame: Episodic tachycardia in a pregnant patient
salient_findings: Regular cannon waves on jugular venous pulsations
key_facts: Patient is a primigravid in their 20s
In eighth month of gestation
Episodic palpitations lasting a few minutes
No associated sweating, syncope, dyspnoea, orthopnoea, or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea
Blood pressure 110/70 mm Hg
Heart rate 120 beats/min
Normal complete blood cell count, kidney function, liver function, thyroid function, serum electrolytes, and cardiac troponin
2-dimensional transthoracic echocardiography showed good biventricular function and normally functioning valves
ECG findings: regular narrow QRS tachycardia at a ventricular rate of 103-125 beats/min

In eighth month of gestation

Blood pressure 110/70 mm Hg
Heart rate 120 beats/min

shortlist.label: Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Regular narrow QRS tachycardia at a ventricular rate of 103-125 beats/min and presence of P waves marching onto QRS complexes

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Episodic palpitations and ECG findings consistent with supraventricular tachycardia

shortlist.label: Atrial Flutter
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of regular narrow QRS tachycardia and presence of P waves

shortlist.label: Inappropriate Sinus Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Sinus tachycardia at a rate of 100-125 beats/min and absence of other clear causes for tachycardia

shortlist.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of supraventricular tachycardia and presence of regular narrow QRS tachycardia

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG shows regular narrow QRS tachycardia with a ventricular rate of 103-125 beats/min and regular P waves marching onto QRS complexes, which is consistent with AVNRT. The presence of cannon waves in the jugular venous pulsations also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia
rejected.why: Too broad, as AVNRT is a specific type of PSVT

rejected.label: Atrial Flutter
rejected.why: Typically characterized by a sawtooth pattern on ECG, which is not mentioned

rejected.label: Inappropriate Sinus Tachycardia
rejected.why: Sinus tachycardia would have a P wave preceding each QRS complex with a consistent PR interval, which is not the case here

rejected.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome
rejected.why: Typically characterized by a delta wave on ECG, which is not mentioned
